def primes_up_to(n: int) -> list[int]:
    sieve = bytearray([1]) * (n + 1)
    sieve[0:2] = b"\x00\x00"
    for i in range(2, int(n**0.5) + 1):
        if sieve[i]:
            sieve[i * i :: i] = b"\x00" * len(sieve[i * i :: i])
    return [i for i, p in enumerate(sieve) if p]
